game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Lajota
quote: The ambience, combat, gameplay, graphics, storytelling, samurai way, friendship, vengeance, a samurai turning into ghost, it's all in it. I was amazed at all the feelings this game makes you experience, you really get into that world and feel like a true samurai. Combat is absolutely gorgeous, the diversity of weapons at your disposal, the armors, the legendary techniques and the lore behind it, not to mention the amazing 1x1 duels. Yes, I can easily say **** Punch delivered us the absolute best game of this generation, and one of the best of all time. Everyone should experience it. This truly is a masterpiece.
